statements.proposition: This change keeps full backward compatibility and significantly improves maintainability and readability.
statements.label: CANNOT_TELL
statements.note: Impact claim. The diff removes no public function or class and keeps AnalysisAgent and RelevancyAgent names (now subclassing a new BaseAgent), which is consistent with compatibility; but api/graph.py was restructured (+60/-39) and I did not run behaviour tests, so 'full' compatibility is not settled. 'Significantly improving maintainability and readability' is a quality judgment the rules say not to make; the PR itself reports the pylint score fell from 8.39 to 8.17. No concrete check settles the sentence.
evidence: PR 56 file list: 14 files, 1 added (api/agents/base_agent.py), 13 modified
Diff def/class lines: only additions of BaseAgent and three private helpers in api/graph.py; no removed public def/class other than the moved __init__ methods
PR message states starting score 8.39/10 and final score 8.17/10
